"""逐条保存用户要求的共享工作区检查，不复用旧返回码。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round9-shared-checks'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
commands = [
    ['git', 'diff', '--check'], ['git', 'status', '--short'], ['rustc', '-Vv'], [sys.executable, '--version'],
    ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check'],
    ['cargo', 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'build', '--workspace', '--release', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'],
]
report = {'checked_head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip(),
          'started_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'checks': [],
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
for index, command in enumerate(commands, 1):
    if command[0] in {'git', 'rustc', 'cargo'}:
        command[0] = shutil.which(command[0], path=env['PATH']) or command[0]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    row = {'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': time.perf_counter() - start}
    for name, raw in [('stdout', result.stdout), ('stderr', result.stderr)]:
        path = OUT / f'command-{index:02}-{name}.txt'
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        row[name] = {'file': path.name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    report['checks'].append(row)
    (OUT / 'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'check': index, 'code': result.returncode, 'seconds': row['seconds']}), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in report['checks']) else 1)

"""固定本轮实际共享diff和未变源码；不代用户作人工决定。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round9-review'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
MAIN = 'a564fd47b0f054ff360592af3ccb8d744021160f'
BASE = '607c2c11227cb9a9e5507b0fa0bc0aae1cf503ea'


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
assert git('rev-parse', 'origin/main').decode().strip() == MAIN
assert not git('diff', '--name-only', BASE, '--', 'crates', 'apps', 'scripts', 'tests', 'data', 'config', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml', 'README.md')
paths = [row.split('\t')[-1] for row in git('diff', '--name-status', MAIN, head).decode('utf-8').splitlines()]
stream = io.BytesIO(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=ROOT, input=''.join(head + ':' + p + '\n' for p in paths).encode('utf-8')))
changes = []
for name in paths:
    oid, kind, size = stream.readline().decode().split()
    assert kind == 'blob'
    raw = stream.read(int(size))
    assert stream.read(1) == b'\n'
    changes.append({'path': name, 'git_blob_sha1': oid, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw)})
patch = git('diff', '--full-index', '--binary', MAIN, head)
(OUT / 'main-to-reviewed-head.patch').write_bytes(patch)
core = {p: {'git_blob_sha1': git('rev-parse', head + ':' + p).decode().strip(), 'sha256': sha(git('show', head + ':' + p))}
        for p in ['crates/cloudleaf-input/src/lib.rs', 'crates/cloudleaf-types/src/lib.rs']}
directions = []
for label, current in [('cl007-windows', '1a05633c27c133bc0558b0fb955b0f916edb6b72'),
                       ('cl008-search', '2751b1512394e09c92bca2b4329456c3cd3c30de'),
                       ('cl009-data', '1c9a047c74aea01e504ed355601c0fe021b53f4b')]:
    work = Path.home() / '.codex/worktrees' / label / 'Cloudleaf'
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=work).decode().strip() == current
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=work)
    values = {p: git('rev-parse', current + ':' + p).decode().strip() for p in core}
    assert all(values[p] == core[p]['git_blob_sha1'] for p in core)
    directions.append({'worktree': label, 'final_head': current, 'merge_base': git('merge-base', head, current).decode().strip(), 'core_blobs': values})
old_reports = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', BASE, 'docs/reports').decode().splitlines()
assert not git('diff', '--name-only', BASE, '--', *old_reports)
decision = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round9-decision-template.json').read_bytes())
assert decision['decision'] == 'pending' and decision['reviewer_id'] is None and not decision['merge_execution_authorized']
validation = json.loads((ROOT / '.local/round9-shared-checks/validation.json').read_bytes())
assert validation['checked_head'] == head and len(validation['checks']) == 11 and all(r['returncode'] == 0 for r in validation['checks'])
rust = (ROOT / '.local/round9-shared-checks/command-07-stdout.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
python = (ROOT / '.local/round9-shared-checks/command-11-stderr.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
result = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'reviewed_head': head, 'main': MAIN, 'remote_PR_start_head': BASE,
    'source_unchanged_from_round8': True, 'main_to_reviewed_changes': changes, 'patch_bytes': len(patch), 'patch_sha256': sha(patch),
    'critical_sources': core, 'direction_final_identities': directions, 'historical_reports_unchanged': len(old_reports),
    'local_checks_passed': 11, 'rust_passed': sum(map(int, re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed', rust))),
    'python_tests': int(re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests', python).group(1)), 'human_decision': 'pending',
    'checklist_git_sha256': sha(git('show', BASE + ':docs/reviews/pr1-round8-human-review.md')),
    'supplement_physical_sha256': sha((ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round9-human-review.md').read_bytes()),
    'final_full_diff_and_CI': 'Record separately after report commit; this snapshot is not final-head CI',
    'new_shared_P0_P1_reproduced': [], 'tool_sha256': sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())}
(OUT / 'review.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ['reviewed_head', 'source_unchanged_from_round8', 'patch_bytes', 'historical_reports_unchanged', 'rust_passed', 'python_tests', 'human_decision']}))

"""独立读取最终Git发布字节与保留原件，不代人工或平台验收。"""
import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

label, worktree, start, final, prefix = sys.argv[1:]
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
WORK = Path(worktree)
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round9-independent-artifacts'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
target = OUT / (label + '.json')
assert not target.exists()
result = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'start': start, 'final_head': final,
          'reviewer_type': 'AI technical audit, not human approval', 'failures': [], 'passed': False}


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=WORK)


def blob(name, revision=final):
    return git('show', revision + ':' + name)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


try:
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == final
    assert not git('status', '--porcelain')
    manifest = json.loads(blob(prefix + '/checksums.json'))
    manifest = manifest.get('sha256', manifest.get('files'))
    for name, expected in manifest.items():
        assert sha(blob(prefix + '/' + name)) == expected, name
    paths = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', final, prefix).decode().splitlines()
    envelopes = {}
    files_matched, reconstructed = 0, 0
    for name in paths:
        if Path(name).name not in {'raw-artifacts.json', 'original-logs.json', 'original-artifacts.json'}:
            continue
        rows = json.loads(blob(name))['files']
        rows = rows.values() if isinstance(rows, dict) else rows
        count = 0
        for row in rows:
            raw = row['utf8'].encode('utf-8')
            assert len(raw) == row['bytes'] and sha(raw) == row['sha256'], name
            if row.get('original_path') is not None:
                assert Path(row['original_path']).read_bytes() == raw, row['original_path']
                files_matched += 1
            reconstructed += 1
            count += 1
        envelopes[name] = count
    runner_names = [name for name in paths if Path(name).name == 'runners.json']
    runner_count = 0
    for name in runner_names:
        for row in json.loads(blob(name))['sources']:
            raw = row['utf8'].encode('utf-8')
            assert len(raw) == row['bytes'] and sha(raw) == row['sha256']
            runner_count += 1
    old_reports = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', start, 'docs/reports').decode().splitlines()
    assert not git('diff', '--name-only', start, final, '--', *old_reports)
    assert not git('diff', '--name-only', start, final, '--', 'crates', 'apps', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'data/sources')
    deleted = git('diff', '--name-only', '--diff-filter=D', start, final, '--', 'tests', 'crates').decode().splitlines()
    assert not deleted
    modified_tests = git('diff', '--name-only', '--diff-filter=M', start, final, '--', 'tests').decode().splitlines()
    for name in modified_tests:
        if name.endswith('.py'):
            before = {node.name for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(blob(name, start).decode('utf-8'))) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name.startswith('test_')}
            after = {node.name for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(blob(name).decode('utf-8'))) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name.startswith('test_')}
            assert before <= after, (name, sorted(before - after))
    result.update(git_manifest_files=len(manifest), original_envelopes=envelopes, original_files_matched=files_matched,
                  original_byte_sequences_reconstructed=reconstructed, runner_sources_matched=runner_count,
                  historical_reports_unchanged=len(old_reports), rust_production_changed=False, deleted_old_tests=deleted,
                  changed_files=git('diff', '--name-status', start, final).decode('utf-8').splitlines(), passed=True)
except Exception as error:
    result['failures'].append({'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)})
    raise
finally:
    result['audit_tool_sha256'] = sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    target.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != 'changed_files'}, ensure_ascii=False))

"""只读记录四工作区、公开PR与精确R8 push CI，不重跑旧验收。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import urllib.request

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round9-baseline'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
API = 'https://api.github.com/repos/WanFengQC/Cloudleaf'
MAIN = 'a564fd47b0f054ff360592af3ccb8d744021160f'
CONFIG = [
    ('shared', ROOT, 'codex/cl007-009-contracts', '607c2c11227cb9a9e5507b0fa0bc0aae1cf503ea', 1, 40917073785),
    ('A', Path.home() / '.codex/worktrees/cl007-windows/Cloudleaf', 'codex/cl007-windows', '333dc90e0985a13f75629e29599f3df1d7d951ab', 4, 40915423624),
    ('B', Path.home() / '.codex/worktrees/cl008-search/Cloudleaf', 'codex/cl008-search', 'f991a8128cd07d4af57eb773cc2e598cf7e5809a', 2, 40912373247),
    ('C', Path.home() / '.codex/worktrees/cl009-data/Cloudleaf', 'codex/cl009-data', 'ef6cf16c558f5521cd776e4805068a07f15aedd2', 3, 40915671708),
]
report = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'scope': 'Read-only baseline snapshot; old CI is not evidence for later commits',
          'tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'gh_available_in_PATH': shutil.which('gh') is not None,
          'commands': [], 'HTTP_responses': [], 'worktrees': [], 'ci': [], 'failures': []}


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def save():
    (OUT / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def git(work, *args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=work, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    index = len(report['commands']) + 1
    row = {'cwd': str(work), 'argv': ['git', *args], 'returncode': result.returncode}
    for label, raw in [('stdout', result.stdout), ('stderr', result.stderr)]:
        path = OUT / f'command-{index:02}-{label}.txt'
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        row[label] = {'path': path.name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw)}
    report['commands'].append(row)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise ValueError('只读Git命令失败：' + ' '.join(args))
    return result.stdout.decode('utf-8').strip()


def fetch(suffix, name):
    request = urllib.request.Request(API + suffix, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'Cloudleaf-Round9-readonly-baseline'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
        raw = response.read()
        receipt = {'url': API + suffix, 'status': response.status, 'file': name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'headers': dict(response.headers)}
    (OUT / name).write_bytes(raw)
    report['HTTP_responses'].append(receipt)
    return json.loads(raw)


try:
    report['local_main'] = git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'main')
    report['origin_main'] = git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'origin/main')
    report['worktree_inventory'] = git(ROOT, 'worktree', 'list', '--porcelain')
    for label, work, branch, expected, number, run_id in CONFIG:
        row = {'label': label, 'path': str(work), 'branch': git(work, 'branch', '--show-current'),
               'head': git(work, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'expected_round8_head': expected,
               'status_porcelain': git(work, 'status', '--porcelain'),
               'origin_head': git(work, 'rev-parse', 'origin/' + branch),
               'merge_base_with_shared_start': git(ROOT, 'merge-base', CONFIG[0][3], expected)}
        row['matches_expected_branch_and_head'] = row['branch'] == branch and row['head'] == expected
        row['local_remote_equal'] = row['head'] == row['origin_head']
        report['worktrees'].append(row)
        pr = fetch(f'/pulls/{number}', f'pr-{number}.json')
        row['PR'] = {'number': number, 'state': pr['state'], 'draft': pr['draft'], 'merged': pr['merged'],
                     'head_sha': pr['head']['sha'], 'head_ref': pr['head']['ref'], 'base_sha': pr['base']['sha'],
                     'base_ref': pr['base']['ref'], 'mergeable': pr['mergeable']}
        assert pr['state'] == 'open' and pr['draft'] and not pr['merged'] and pr['head']['sha'] == expected
        assert pr['base']['ref'] == ('main' if number == 1 else CONFIG[0][2])
        runs = fetch(f'/actions/runs?head_sha={expected}&event=push&per_page=10', f'{label}-runs.json')
        run = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}', f'{label}-run.json')
        jobs = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100', f'{label}-jobs.json')['jobs']
        artifacts = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/artifacts?per_page=100', f'{label}-artifacts.json')['artifacts']
        assert any(value['id'] == run_id and value['head_sha'] == expected and value['event'] == 'push' for value in runs['workflow_runs'])
        assert run['head_sha'] == expected and run['event'] == 'push' and run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success'
        assert len(jobs) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in jobs} == {'core (windows-latest)', 'core (ubuntu-latest)'}
        assert all(value['head_sha'] == expected and value['status'] == 'completed' and value['conclusion'] == 'success'
                   and all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps']) for value in jobs)
        assert len(artifacts) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in artifacts} == {'core-performance-windows-latest', 'core-performance-ubuntu-latest'}
        assert all(not value['expired'] and value['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == expected and value['digest'].startswith('sha256:') for value in artifacts)
        report['ci'].append({'label': label, 'head_sha': expected, 'run_id': run_id, 'event': run['event'], 'conclusion': run['conclusion'], 'verified_pass': True,
            'jobs': [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'steps': len(value['steps'])} for value in jobs],
            'artifacts': [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'digest': value['digest'], 'expired': value['expired']} for value in artifacts]})
        save()
        print(json.dumps({'label': label, 'head': row['head'], 'clean_at_snapshot': not row['status_porcelain'], 'CI_verified': True}), flush=True)
    main = fetch('/branches/main', 'main.json')
    report['remote_main'] = main['commit']['sha']
    assert report['local_main'] == report['origin_main'] == report['remote_main'] == MAIN
    report['external_state'] = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round8-evidence/external-state.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    report['solo_engineering'] = ['只读环境/快照/回滚/授权材料准入核验与拒绝启动', '固定Ngrams原件只读结构/单位/缺失报告', '原创个人标注队列/导出及缺件状态，正式独立gold门禁保留', '共享PR差异/身份/CI及人工决定材料']
    report['user_only_decisions'] = ['PR #1实际人工审查、决定与另行合并批准', '真实隔离环境/负责人/快照与回滚验证/执行授权', '原创个人标注及其实际授权范围']
    report['external_real_evidence'] = ['连续8h/24h真实运行及完整证据', '另批TSF真实应用验收', '两位真实独立审核者、必要仲裁及独立heldout保管', '统计口径/来源采用与真实语义审读']
    report['CL010_allowed'] = False
    report['baseline_verified'] = True
except Exception as error:
    report['failures'].append({'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)})
    report['baseline_verified'] = False
    raise
finally:
    report['completed_at_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    save()

"""为R9新提交保存一次精确push CI快照；旧记录不覆盖。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import urllib.request

label, commit, run_id = sys.argv[1:]
run_id = int(run_id)
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round9-ci' / label
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
API = 'https://api.github.com/repos/WanFengQC/Cloudleaf'
record = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'head_sha': commit, 'run_id': run_id,
          'tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'HTTP_responses': [], 'verified_pass': False}


def fetch(suffix, name):
    url = API + suffix
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'Cloudleaf-Round9-exact-push-CI'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
        raw = response.read()
        record['HTTP_responses'].append({'url': url, 'status': response.status, 'file': name, 'bytes': len(raw),
                                         'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'headers': dict(response.headers)})
    (OUT / name).write_bytes(raw)
    return json.loads(raw)


try:
    runs = fetch(f'/actions/runs?head_sha={commit}&event=push&per_page=10', 'runs.json')
    run = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}', 'run.json')
    jobs = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100', 'jobs.json')['jobs']
    artifacts = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/artifacts?per_page=100', 'artifacts.json')['artifacts']
    assert any(value['id'] == run_id and value['head_sha'] == commit and value['event'] == 'push' for value in runs['workflow_runs'])
    assert run['head_sha'] == commit and run['event'] == 'push'
    record.update({'url': run['html_url'], 'event': run['event'], 'status': run['status'], 'conclusion': run['conclusion']})
    record['jobs'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['head_sha'], 'status': value['status'],
                       'conclusion': value['conclusion'], 'steps': len(value['steps']),
                       'steps_ok': all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps'])} for value in jobs]
    record['artifacts'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['workflow_run']['head_sha'],
                            'expired': value['expired'], 'digest': value.get('digest')} for value in artifacts]
    jobs_ok = len(jobs) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in jobs} == {'core (windows-latest)', 'core (ubuntu-latest)'}
    jobs_ok = jobs_ok and all(value['head_sha'] == commit and value['status'] == 'completed' and value['conclusion'] == 'success'
                              and all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps']) for value in jobs)
    artifacts_ok = len(artifacts) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in artifacts} == {'core-performance-windows-latest', 'core-performance-ubuntu-latest'}
    artifacts_ok = artifacts_ok and all(not value['expired'] and value['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == commit
                                        and value.get('digest', '').startswith('sha256:') for value in artifacts)
    record['verified_pass'] = run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' and jobs_ok and artifacts_ok
except Exception as error:
    record['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    raise
finally:
    (OUT / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({name: value for name, value in record.items() if name != 'HTTP_responses'}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import sys
import subprocess
import urllib.request

credential_result = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'credential.interactive=never', 'credential', 'fill'],
    input=b'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n', stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
if credential_result.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError('已有Git凭据不可用；未请求远程修改或保存凭据内容')
credential = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in credential_result.stdout.decode('utf-8').splitlines() if '=' in line)
authorization = 'Bearer ' + credential['password']

label, commit, run_id = sys.argv[1:]
run_id = int(run_id)
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round9-ci' / label
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
API = 'https://api.github.com/repos/WanFengQC/Cloudleaf'
record = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'head_sha': commit, 'run_id': run_id,
          'authentication': 'Existing Git credential, process memory only; anonymous quota low (5/60)', 'tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'HTTP_responses': [], 'verified_pass': False}


def fetch(suffix, name):
    url = API + suffix
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'Cloudleaf-Round9-exact-push-CI', 'Authorization': authorization})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
        raw = response.read()
        record['HTTP_responses'].append({'url': url, 'status': response.status, 'file': name, 'bytes': len(raw),
                                         'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'headers': dict(response.headers)})
    (OUT / name).write_bytes(raw)
    return json.loads(raw)


try:
    runs = fetch(f'/actions/runs?head_sha={commit}&event=push&per_page=10', 'runs.json')
    run = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}', 'run.json')
    jobs = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100', 'jobs.json')['jobs']
    artifacts = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/artifacts?per_page=100', 'artifacts.json')['artifacts']
    assert any(value['id'] == run_id and value['head_sha'] == commit and value['event'] == 'push' for value in runs['workflow_runs'])
    assert run['head_sha'] == commit and run['event'] == 'push'
    record.update({'url': run['html_url'], 'event': run['event'], 'status': run['status'], 'conclusion': run['conclusion']})
    record['jobs'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['head_sha'], 'status': value['status'],
                       'conclusion': value['conclusion'], 'steps': len(value['steps']),
                       'steps_ok': all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps'])} for value in jobs]
    record['artifacts'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['workflow_run']['head_sha'],
                            'expired': value['expired'], 'digest': value.get('digest')} for value in artifacts]
    jobs_ok = len(jobs) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in jobs} == {'core (windows-latest)', 'core (ubuntu-latest)'}
    jobs_ok = jobs_ok and all(value['head_sha'] == commit and value['status'] == 'completed' and value['conclusion'] == 'success'
                              and all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps']) for value in jobs)
    artifacts_ok = len(artifacts) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in artifacts} == {'core-performance-windows-latest', 'core-performance-ubuntu-latest'}
    artifacts_ok = artifacts_ok and all(not value['expired'] and value['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == commit
                                        and value.get('digest', '').startswith('sha256:') for value in artifacts)
    record['verified_pass'] = run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' and jobs_ok and artifacts_ok
except Exception as error:
    record['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    raise
finally:
    (OUT / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({name: value for name, value in record.items() if name != 'HTTP_responses'}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

"""独立保存新HEAD的push发现/轮询快照，不覆盖历史响应。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import subprocess
import urllib.request

credential_result = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'credential.interactive=never', 'credential', 'fill'],
    input=b'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n', stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
if credential_result.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError('已有Git凭据不可用；未请求远程修改或保存凭据内容')
credential = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in credential_result.stdout.decode('utf-8').splitlines() if '=' in line)
authorization = 'Bearer ' + credential['password']

label, commit = sys.argv[1:]
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round9-ci/discovery'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ')
path = OUT / (label + '-' + stamp + '.json')
url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/WanFengQC/Cloudleaf/actions/runs?head_sha={commit}&event=push&per_page=10'
record = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'head_sha': commit, 'url': url,
          'authentication': 'Existing Git credential, process memory only; anonymous quota low (5/60)', 'tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
try:
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'Cloudleaf-Round9-exact-push-discovery', 'Authorization': authorization})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
        raw = response.read()
        record.update({'status': response.status, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'headers': dict(response.headers), 'raw_utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')})
    rows = json.loads(raw)['workflow_runs']
    assert all(row['head_sha'] == commit and row['event'] == 'push' for row in rows)
    record['runs'] = [{'id': row['id'], 'event': row['event'], 'head_sha': row['head_sha'], 'status': row['status'], 'conclusion': row['conclusion'], 'html_url': row['html_url']} for row in rows]
except Exception as error:
    record['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    raise
finally:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'snapshot': str(path), 'runs': record.get('runs'), 'error': record.get('error')}, ensure_ascii=False))

"""保存R9各方向实际结果与共享原件；不合方向代码或代签。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REVIEW = ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round9-evidence'
SHARED = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007-009-round9-shared'
REVIEW.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
SHARED.mkdir(exist_ok=False)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def save(folder, name, value):
    (folder / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def original(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {'original_path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')}


validation = read(ROOT / '.local/round9-shared-checks/validation.json')
assert len(validation['checks']) == 11 and all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in validation['checks'])
save(REVIEW, 'validation.json', validation)
logs = {}
for path in sorted((ROOT / '.local/round9-shared-checks').iterdir()):
    if path.is_file():
        logs[path.name] = original(path)
        if path.suffix == '.txt':
            text = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()).rstrip()
            (REVIEW / path.name).write_text(text + ('\n' if text else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
save(REVIEW, 'originals.json', {'encoding': 'utf8.encode reconstructs original process bytes', 'files': logs})
save(REVIEW, 'initial-launch-failure.json', {'files': {p.name: original(p) for p in sorted((ROOT / '.local/round9-shared-checks-initial').iterdir()) if p.is_file()}})
save(REVIEW, 'harness-preparation.json', read(ROOT / '.local/round9-harness-preparation.json'))
save(REVIEW, 'review.json', read(ROOT / '.local/round9-review/review.json'))
save(REVIEW, 'peer-review.json', read(ROOT / '.local/round9-peer-review.json'))
baseline = ROOT / '.local/round9-baseline'
assert read(baseline / 'summary.json')['baseline_verified']
save(REVIEW, 'baseline.json', {'summary': read(baseline / 'summary.json'),
     'raw_originals': {p.name: original(p) for p in sorted(baseline.iterdir()) if p.is_file()}})
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('root_identity_only', ROOT / 'scripts/benchmark.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
binary = ROOT / 'target/release/cloudleaf-cli.exe'
save(REVIEW, 'identity.json', {'checked_head': validation['checked_head'], 'source_sha256': module.source_sha256(), 'source_fingerprint_schema': 'cloudleaf-source-v2',
     'binary': {'path': str(binary), 'bytes': binary.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(binary.read_bytes()), 'benchmark_executed': False},
     'human_decision': 'pending', 'human_fields_filled_by_Codex': False})
save(SHARED, 'direction-artifacts.json', {name: read(ROOT / '.local/round9-independent-artifacts' / (name + '.json')) for name in ['A', 'B', 'C']})
ci, raw_ci = [], {}
for label, expected in [('A-final', '1a05633c27c133bc0558b0fb955b0f916edb6b72'),
                        ('B-final', '2751b1512394e09c92bca2b4329456c3cd3c30de'),
                        ('C-final', '1c9a047c74aea01e504ed355601c0fe021b53f4b')]:
    folder = ROOT / '.local/round9-ci' / label
    run = read(folder / 'run.json')
    jobs = read(folder / 'jobs.json')['jobs']
    artifacts = read(folder / 'artifacts.json')['artifacts']
    assert run['head_sha'] == expected and run['event'] == 'push' and run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success'
    assert len(jobs) == 2 and {row['name'] for row in jobs} == {'core (windows-latest)', 'core (ubuntu-latest)'}
    assert all(row['head_sha'] == expected and row['conclusion'] == 'success' and all(step['conclusion'] in ['success', 'skipped'] for step in row['steps']) for row in jobs)
    assert len(artifacts) == 2 and all(not row['expired'] and row['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == expected and row['digest'].startswith('sha256:') for row in artifacts)
    ci.append({'label': label, 'head_sha': expected, 'run_id': run['id'], 'event': 'push', 'conclusion': 'success', 'verified_pass': True,
        'jobs': [{'name': row['name'], 'steps': len(row['steps'])} for row in jobs],
        'artifacts': [{'id': row['id'], 'name': row['name'], 'digest': row['digest']} for row in artifacts]})
    for name in ['runs.json', 'run.json', 'jobs.json', 'artifacts.json']:
        raw_ci[label + '/' + name] = original(folder / name)
save(SHARED, 'direction-ci.json', {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'records': ci, 'original_HTTP_bodies': raw_ci,
     'authentication_scope': 'Read-only official API; existing Git credentials used only in memory after anonymous limit became low; no credential saved.'})
save(SHARED, 'direction-changes.json', {'direction_evidence': {name: read(ROOT / '.local/round9-independent-artifacts' / (name + '.json'))['changed_files'] for name in ['A', 'B', 'C']},
     'identities_and_compatibility': read(ROOT / '.local/round9-review/review.json')['direction_final_identities'], 'integration_performed': False})
decision = read(ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round9-decision-template.json')
assert decision['template_only'] and decision['decision'] == 'pending' and decision['reviewer_id'] is None
assert not decision['merge_execution_authorized'] and not decision['merge_executed']
links = 0
for name in ['docs/reviews/pr1-round9-human-review.md', 'docs/reports/cl007-009-round9-status.md']:
    path = ROOT / name
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
        if not target.startswith('https://'):
            assert (path.parent / target.split('#')[0]).resolve().is_file(), (name, target)
            links += 1
save(REVIEW, 'template-and-links.json', {'human_decision': 'pending', 'links_checked': links,
     'template_physical_sha256': sha((ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round9-decision-template.json').read_bytes()),
     'supplement_physical_sha256': sha((ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round9-human-review.md').read_bytes())})
sources = []
for name in ['run_round9_shared.py', 'review_round9_pr1.py', 'audit_round9_direction.py', 'check_round9_baseline.py',
             'collect_round9_ci.py', 'collect_round9_ci_authenticated.py', 'discover_round9_ci_authenticated.py', 'publish_round9_shared.py']:
    path = ROOT / '.local' / name
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    sources.append({'name': name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')})
save(SHARED, 'runners.json', {'sources': sources, 'scope': 'Read paths and output guards before replay; no system input or long run authorized.'})
for folder in [REVIEW, SHARED]:
    save(folder, 'checksums.json', {'scope': 'Git-normalized LF display bytes; original process bytes separately enveloped',
        'sha256': {p.name: sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(folder.iterdir()) if p.is_file()}})
print(json.dumps({'local_commands': 11, 'direction_ci_verified': 3, 'links_checked': links, 'raw_logs': len(logs), 'human_decision': 'pending'}))

scope: Read paths and output guards before replay; no system input or long run authorized.
